who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), joiner lane, D163 request R1
what: D119's written-and-unwired body record (blaze-body kept.rs, put/read in engine_body_record.rs, made by front2 tables/task.rs `keep_checked`, which nothing calls) holds the LOWERED body (blaze-body rows), not the checker's columns, so it cannot answer `TypedRecords::typed(key) -> Checked`. A second record of the checked columns was written (blaze-typeck checked_record.rs). Both are made from one check; neither is put by the engine yet.
cost: two records per clean body once both are wired; the checked record is encoded on every finished clean check (front2 borrows.rs `check_borrows_in`), put or not
cause: the run path still builds from `Checked` (blaze-build reads the checker's columns), while D119's end state builds from the kept body
whys: the run writer's lazy front end needs `Checked` today; the kept body is the end-state input whose builder (blaze-body-build) has no dependents
class: two records of one value while a switch is half done (rule 30)
prevention: when blaze-body-build becomes the run's builder, the run reads the kept body and the checked record goes, with `TypedRecords`; until then the checked record is the one the run reads
annoyance: write-only lane: the round-trip property (every suite body through `check_body`) cannot be run here
workaround: the suite's one entry (`check_body`) asserts the round trip and two-checks-equal on every clean body; controls in suite/checked_record.rs
